name: Personally favorite minecraft mod
body:
I think the best mod in minercaft is SIMPLELY, twilight forest.
Like, the bosses are PERFECT. they have their own unique abilities, phases etc.
Also, the player leveling? system is kinda good. I don't know what word to use.
You enter the dimension, fight boss, become stronger.
And always, it isn't just "easy" it's hard. It's HARD. When first playthrough tho.
Anyways, I recently played the mod with my friend and it was fun.
Hope ya'll enjoy.
I left the link for download.
